title: The Owner sees a flow as running, with its dial, figures and controls moving, while a cycle is in flight, and a second run of the same flow waits
description: On 2026-11-10 three hunt cycles of the Frequency Saturation Engine ran at once from 16:00 to 16:03 on the Owner's Mac while flowweb.app said 0 running and Nothing is due, so none of the live visuals moved. The Supervisor's facts hardcoded running 0 for every flow, so a flow never reached the running state and the wip gate never held a second fire. fwd now counts its own cycles in flight by flow key (daemon.ts cycles set) and passes the count to supervisorView and to the fire decision through SupervisorDeps.inFlight: GET /v1/supervisor answers state running and running N while a cycle is in flight, and a second fire of the same flow is held at wip. A caller outside fwd (the CLI reading the database) passes nothing and never claims a live run. On the site, the hosted mirror has no event stream, so LiveProvider refreshes every screen once when a status read shows a newer push (data_as_of). A running flow gives its hero card (FlowHero), its figures on the flow page and its Controls row a live-edge class: a light runs along the card's edge and the state word carries a pinging dot, all from design tokens. Idle cards get no class. Reduced motion and calm mode hide the moving light and keep a still teal outline. No em dashes.
acceptance: While a cycle is in flight GET /v1/supervisor answers the flow's state running and running 1
A second run of the same flow while one is in flight is held at wip and starts no second cycle
A running flow gives its hero card and its Controls row a live class and a pulsing dot; an idle flow has none
On the hosted mirror a newer push refreshes the page without a reload
Reduced motion and calm mode keep a still difference instead of motion
